summary: Persistent-v3 image acquisition, revalidation and rootless context/evidence checks must not launch independent stat subprocesses outside the inherited command-custody channel. The cited source reads owner/type metadata through one retained O_PATH|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC descriptor and the fixed Linux statx ABI, requires returned UID/type/mode fields, and refuses unsupported process profiles, final symlinks and special files. Actual descriptor tests cover regular/empty files, directories, Unicode, links, FIFO, missing/NUL paths, replacement and descriptor cleanup. Surrounding parent custody checks and later path-read revalidation remain necessary: metadata is an observation, not custody of a subsequent read. This source boundary supplies no production root-command producer, authentic provider, native process-custody, cold-image or installed/activation acceptance.
title: Receiver metadata checks stay within the caller process
